approvalCode.description: Code assigned by the authorising institution indicating approval

cardAcceptorNameLocation.description: The name and place where the terminal is located. Note - A backslash is not valid json. So a backslash will be escaped (with a backslash)

cardExpiryDate.description: The year and month after which the card expires

cardValidationResult.description: Contains the result of a CVC2/CVV2 validation or the (i)CVC/CVV validation

channel.description: Channel code (0 atm, 1 pos, 2 eCommerce, 3 moto)

contactlessIndicator.description: Indicates whether the transaction has been done contactless (0 no, 1 yes)

forwardingInstitutionId.description: Code identifying the acquirer processor or card acceptor

iccDateFilled.description: EMV data present. Y or N

paymentFacilitatorId.description: Identifier for a Payment Facilitator which allows anyone who wants to offer merchant services on a sub-merchant platform.

pointOfServiceDataOnline.description: A code used to indicate the local conditions at the point-of-service device, at the time a card payment transaction was initiated.

pointOfServiceDataOffline.description: A code used to identify terminal capability, terminal environment and presentation of security data.

posEntryMode.description: A code that identifies how the carddata was entered on the terminal and which PINentry capabilities the terminal possesses.

processingCode.description: Code which indicates the type of transaction being undertaken. Used in conjunction with the Account type code as part of the Processing code.

responseCodeExternal.description: Response Code from the authorization response received from the brand gateway

retrievalReferenceNumber.description: Retrieval Reference Number from the authorization request sent to Mastercard/Visa

serviceCode.description: The service code from the track

subMerchantId.description: Sub Merchant ID, defined by a Payment Facilitator (merchant). Each merchant that is considered to be a “Payment Facilitator” by MasterCard needs to uniquely identify all of its sites with a sub merchant ID

truncatedPan.description: truncated pan. Only the first 6 and last 3 digits are present. Values inbetween are zeros

amount.description:
Amount in the major units of the currency according to ISO 4217.

In case of euro, "3.10" (is 3.10 euro)

acquirerId.description: Unique identification of the acquirer, determined by equensWorldline

holdingId.description: Unique identification of the holding, determined by equensWorldline

merchantId.description: Unique identification of the merchant, determined by the acquirer

contractId.description: Unique identification of the contract, determined by the acquirer

cardAcceptorId.description: Unique identification of the cardAcceptor within the contract

siteId.description: Unique identification of the site within the contract

terminalId.description: Unique code identifying the terminal at the Card acceptor location

transactionId.description: Unique identification for a Cardholder Initiated Transaction

acquirerReferenceNumber.description: Data supplied by an acquirer to assist in identifying a transaction, e.g. for researching retrievals and chargebacks

merchantReference.description: Merchant Reference. This is a reference that the merchant can add to an authorization request towards the terminal by entering it via the keyboard of the merchant.

merchantTransactionReference.description:
*** DEPRECATED*** (Not available in v2.1. please use merchantReference)
Merchant Reference. This is a reference that the merchant can
add to an authorization request towards the terminal by entering it via
the keyboard of the merchant.

pspReference.description: Additional information provided by the concentrator to return on his statement.
